claims.claim_ar: أداة شرطية (لو + فعل) تُستعمل هنا للتمني/التخيّل واستعمالها يرمي إلى إبراز معنى الاستحالة أو التّصور التمنِّي لدى المخاطَب، وبذلك تؤكّد على أن الهداية ليست أمراً يُفرَض بالقوة ولا بيد النبيّ وحده بل هي بمشيئة الله وحكمته.
claims.claim_en: The conditional 'لو شاء الله' functions rhetorically as a hypothetical/wish construction that highlights impossibility or imagined possibility; it emphasizes that guidance cannot be imposed by force and that ultimate guidance is by God's will and wisdom rather than by the Prophet alone.
claims.needs_review_reason: Mapping the rhetorical force of 'لو شاء الله' onto the exact subtype list is interpretive; secondary sources present in the chunks discuss the hypothetical/conditional meaning but do not use the exact technical subtype labels from the target taxonomy.

warnings: Only a small portion of the ayah ('وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ') appears verbatim in the provided source chunks.
